about: Mutants of compiler/check/inc, the incremental check's plan on the Ergo store (capstone S3e, S3E-MODEL S2). The law IncrementalAgreesWithScratch (TestCompilerIncLawsRun) kills each. compiler/check/inc is not in the linked compiler (compiler/api does not import it), so no row regenerates it: `ergo test` reads the mutated source.

mutants.name: inc-drops-negative-read
mutants.from: reads = reads.Append(Read{Via: via, Name: name, Seen: seen})
mutants.rule: A selector into an import that did not resolve is a read: a new export of the name checks its reader again (models/checkinc DropsNegativeRead).

mutants.name: inc-drops-own-negative-read
mutants.from: reads = reads.Append(Read{Via: "", Name: name, Seen: missing})
mutants.rule: A name of the package that did not resolve is a read: a later declaration of it checks its reader again.

mutants.name: inc-drops-local-read
mutants.from: reads = reads.Append(Read{Via: "", Name: name, Seen: seen})
mutants.rule: A name of a package-level declaration of the same package is a read (models/checkinc DropsLocalRead).

mutants.name: inc-plan-ignores-fp
mutants.rule: A declaration whose fingerprint changed is checked again.

mutants.name: inc-lookup-ignores-export
mutants.rule: An importer's lookup sees only exported names, as bind's XRef does (C0/plan.md §4).

mutants.name: inc-lookup-no-import-as-missing
mutants.rule: A selector on a name that is no import differs from a missing name of an import: adding or removing the import checks the reader again.
